gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-bra: Noto Sans Brahmi rides high, with curves left open at the ends. Nasalization spaces its letters well apart and gives curves and straights a single width, a friendly lead-in for the sans-serif text beneath.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-cha: Nasalization floats friendly letters well apart, loose and wide. Noto Sans Cham brings tall rounded lowercase and generous openings, and neither font leans on shading from heavy to light, so they sit together smoothly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-men: Smooth curves, loose spacing, an easy grin of a font. Nasalization handles friendly, unpinched curves up top; Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is the one with tall lowercase and daylight in every curve.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ol-: Bent-wire letters, loosely spaced, with friendly short ascenders. Nasalization carries the personality, and Noto Sans Ol Chiki lets text settle into solid blocks, its curve tails held back, once the lines keep coming.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-numans: Smooth strokes with no brush swell, letters floating well apart. Nasalization is best at friendly display lines, while Numans does best with loosely tracked text and an s whose ends hang far from the spine.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Glowing lines with no taper, every letter spaced open. Neon glows at display size; Noto Sans Hebrew earns its keep with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Glowing Neon letters look like thin steel rod bent into shape. Noto Sans Kaithi settles into text with a dense, steady texture, its lowercase filling the line and the e keeping an open channel.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Glowing Neon draws every letter as a tube of neon glass, tall in the lowercase and open between glyphs. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a dark stripe through each line, curves never closing.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Neon runs like a single glowing thread, tall and loosely spaced. Noto Sans Khmer sits next to it with generous, chisel-notch openings and small letters standing almost capital-sized, so the two feel companionable.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Neon is best at glowing display lines, every stroke traced at one stylus width, while the body font leaves its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook.
